startMessages: {starter} started a heist with {stake} points. Starting in {joinWindow}. Use !join <points> to join the crew.
cooldownMessages: A new heist can start in {cooldownRemaining}. You can still join the current crew of {participantCount} with !join <points> for a share of the {pot} point pot.
reminderMessages: Heist starts in {countdown}. Pot is now {pot} points across {participantCount} viewers. Use !join <points> to get in on the action.
successHeadlines: The crew cracked the vault and got away clean.
The crew blasted through the alarms and escaped with the haul.
The getaway driver nailed the timing and the crew got out.
failureHeadlines: Police captured the whole crew before anyone escaped.
The crew got boxed in and everyone was gunned down.
The alarms tripped early and the crew never made it out.
successCallouts: {winner} dove into the van with {payout} points.
{winner} made it to the getaway car carrying {payout} points.
failureCallouts: {loser} got left behind in the crossfire.
{loser} took a bullet covering the escape.
{loser} was hauled off in cuffs when the exit closed.
sacrificeCallouts: {loser} held the line so {winner} could escape.
{loser} drew the heat long enough for {winner} to get out.
resultSummaries: {winnerCount} got out with {resolvedPot} points while {loserCount} were left behind. Success chance was {successChancePercent}.
insufficientCrewMessages: The crew was too small to leave the hideout. {participantCount} joined, so everyone got their {resolvedPot} points back.
insufficientBalanceMessages: @{viewer} you need at least {stake} points to join this heist.
alreadyJoinedMessages: @{viewer} Viewer has already joined the open heist.
minimumJoinAmountMessages: @{viewer} the minimum join amount for this heist is {minimumJoinAmount} points.
